items.title: OREZ Appearance
items.description: Layout (taskbar or dock), Paper or Ink colours, wallpaper, effects and performance. Preview each choice and try it for 20 seconds before keeping it.

items.title: Wallpaper and appearance
items.description: Open the native appearance controls to choose a background, colours and desktop style.

items.title: Accessibility
items.description: Find display, text, input and assistive-technology options in native Settings.

items.title: Graphics driver (NVIDIA)
items.description: Check whether your NVIDIA card uses the official driver and install it with one click. Secure Boot stays on.

items.title: Display and monitors
items.description: Arrange screens and adjust resolution, scaling and refresh options.

items.title: Sound and volume
items.description: Choose audio devices and adjust input, output and volume.

items.title: Power and battery
items.description: Choose screen, sleep and power behaviour using KDE's native controls.

items.title: Wi-Fi and internet
items.description: Connect to Wi-Fi or wired networks and review connection status.

items.title: Bluetooth
items.description: Pair and manage nearby Bluetooth devices.

items.title: Connect a phone
items.description: Open KDE Connect to pair a phone after approving the request on both devices.

items.title: Find and manage apps
items.description: Browse the OREZ app catalogue. Availability and installation support are shown separately.

items.title: Files and drives
items.description: Open the file manager to browse folders and removable drives.

items.title: Updates
items.description: Open native system settings. A signed OREZ update channel is not yet enabled in this development build.

items.title: Help and recovery
items.description: Read the current safety status and supported next steps. Installation and system restore are not enabled in this development image.

items.title: System information
items.description: Open native system settings and inspect hardware or software details.

items.title: Advanced Linux tools
items.description: Linux terminal, package tools and developer utilities remain available when you choose them.
